title: Healing Wand
description: Healing Wand it adds a healing wand to the game so you can heal pepole it has a cooldown works with all entites in a 5 block radius!
body:
I have developed a modification (mod) that I created during my free time, designed to enhance gameplay by introducing a healing wand feature. This wand has the capability to heal players within a 5-block radius, providing an effective tool for support during gaming sessions. 

In addition to its ability to heal players, the wand can also interact with and heal various mobs. However, it is important to exercise caution while using the wand in proximity to mobs to avoid unintended consequences. 

The mod also includes some additional features to enrich the overall gaming experience. I hope this enhancement adds value and enjoyment to your gameplay.
